# JoshOps AI

JoshOps AI is the company and venture home. PothOS is its distinct software product. Your own AI computing environment. PothOS brings a continuing ArcheAgent, memory, files, local computing, tools and workflows into one personal environment. Connect the AI engines and devices you use, and keep your identity, preferences and work together. Canonical product account entry: https://pothos.joshops.ai/auth.

Public pages: /, /products, /pothos, /business, /developers, /ventures, /research, /learn, /support, /docs, /about, /portfolio, /pricing, /download. Legacy /product and /platform point to /pothos, /help points to /docs and /organizations points to /ventures.

Purpose Link (https://purposelink.joshops.ai/) is a Houston community-resource navigation venture. Bare Sole Media is a creative photography, video, and storytelling venture. Practical software, portable interfaces, and robotics are in research and development.

Your context, ready for what comes next: each ArcheAgent has a continuing home for its memory, files and work across supported devices and connections. PothOS is a full software stack, not a memory-only service or a chat wrapper: the interfaces a person uses, a layer for work, memory and orchestration (memory with sources and corrections, files, tools and workflows, ArcheAgent identity, preferences and permissions), and a local runtime on supported hardware they choose, connected to the supported AI engines and devices they already use. The same environment is designed to grow with custom skins, avatars, voices and new ways to interact; these are future direction, not controls available today. Richer interactive capabilities continue rolling out inside the same PothOS app. Sign in or create an account at https://pothos.joshops.ai/auth.

Why PothOS? Joshua Gustafson-Juarez chose the name PothOS for pothos: the deep yearning toward what is still beyond reach. For him, it expresses the drive to connect the disconnected parts of life and turn intention into useful action.

PothOS is free. Always. PothOS software is free for personal, nonprofit and business use. The software price is $0, with no subscription, per-ArcheAgent, device, seat, business or enterprise software fee. Adding more ArcheAgents never creates a software charge. Free public downloads of JoshOps AI are available, and shared source and documentation are public in the PothOS repository. Standalone runtime source remains separately governed by the published licensing status: https://github.com/joshuagjuarez/PothOS-by-JoshOps-AI/blob/main/LICENSE_STATUS.md. PothOS is for individuals, entrepreneurs, educators, nonprofits, developers and businesses. Existing Apache-2.0 grants cover the specific public materials they name; the published licensing status is not a new runtime license. PothOS exists for human-governed memory continuity across infrastructure, platforms, software, devices and models. It is designed to preserve original meaning and corrections, reduce noise and recover useful signal, so a person can develop themselves and help others. Your thinking stays yours: PothOS is built for cognitive sovereignty and never to exploit your private signal. Each person creates and runs their own ArcheAgents under their own authority, with their own identity, data and permitted connections. The Founder's own ArcheAgents, voices, memories, accounts and environment stay private. Cognitive privacy is a release requirement, not an untested guarantee. Local personal context, explicit choice about external services, permission boundaries, and controls to inspect, correct, export and recover your information must be documented and verified before a standalone build is described as qualified for local use. A hierarchy title never grants actual access, and local software is not automatically secure. Voice work exists in the native project. A consumer package and its microphone, speaker and hardware behavior are still being qualified. Contribution priorities include keyboard navigation, screen-reader labeling, visible microphone permission, recording and cancel behavior, qualified speech input and output, clean packaging, tested local-model adapters, continuity and recovery, permission isolation, and documentation. Purpose Link is a separate, Houston-first community resource navigation project in development and an intended application of the same mission. Global adaptation and social justice uses are goals, not proven worldwide service, and it shares no membership, records or data access with PothOS. Purpose Link: https://purposelink.joshops.ai. Hardware, optional third-party hosting, external AI subscriptions or API usage, and model licenses are separate. There is no promise of unlimited compute or a permanently funded hosted service. The hosted invitation controls access; it is never a payment requirement. Personal, professional, nonprofit and small-business Worlds each keep their own sharing boundary. The hosted beta currently requires an invitation and your own account. Free-access migration is in progress. If your account still shows a payment prompt, contact support; do not start a new paid subscription. The first release provides memory continuity and supported connected AI tools, including compatible MCP connections. Richer interactive presence is coming. Privacy and service: https://pothos.joshops.ai/privacy. Native app-store listings are not live yet. Downloads (https://joshops.ai/download): The connected PothOS web beta is available now to invited testers. On a phone, tablet or computer you can add it to your home screen or dock where supported; it needs an internet connection. Accept the invitation, open PothOS at https://pothos.joshops.ai/auth or install the web app (https://pothos.joshops.ai/install), then connect an eligible AI host with the same account (https://pothos.joshops.ai/connect). Founder: Joshua Gustafson-Juarez (https://joshops.ai/portfolio) is a Houston-based systems architect, software developer and founder of JoshOps AI. He is building PothOS, and his work also includes Purpose Link and Bare Sole Media. His video series is The I'mPerfection Movement (https://www.youtube.com/@Imperfectionmovement). Collaboration enquiries and PothOS support: joshua@joshops.ai. Contact options: https://joshops.ai/support#contact.

JoshOps AI is your local agentic computing environment. Your PothOS and ArcheAgent bring memory, files, tools and ongoing work together across your connected devices. Personal: Keep continuity across your notes, files and projects. Entrepreneur: Organize ventures, contacts and repeatable work. Enterprise: Coordinate accountable work and connect authorized Google Workspace services. Developer: Use connected chat to invoke permitted local tools and workflows, read and edit source, run supported checks and recover work. Personal, Entrepreneur, Enterprise and Developer are uses of the same environment, not separate apps or paid tiers. Designed to work with Google Workspace using each person's own authorized accounts. Build with us. We welcome development, design, testing, documentation, sponsorship and infrastructure partnerships. Support for the project is a contribution, not an investment, and carries no return or equity.
